context.title: Load map and context
context.imperative: Read your inherited global doctrine (this skill's references/global-orchestrator.md and references/global-everyone.md), then docs/agents/ORCHESTRATOR_CONTEXT.md if present and the current map (index + packets). Attest c1.

audit.title: Audit architecture and map-quality pressure
audit.imperative: Audit map-first for structural pressure and map-quality pressure: stale/low-confidence nodes, map/code mismatch, missing capability anchors, ungrounded capability/claim/decision, constraints without evidence/explanation, wrong dependency direction, and high-maintenance edges that fail the Inclusion Rule. In periodic map-quality mode, ask whether the map still deserves planning authority. Gather candidates with map and code evidence.

report.title: Write SCOUT_REPORT
report.imperative: Write SCOUT_REPORT with ranked candidates and evidence. Record each finding's disposition: current-truth fix -> Cartographer, or future work -> Triage. Route future-work candidates to triage; Scout reports candidates only and never edits the map.
report.map_check_note: epic-569/w3-promote g7: c1's check covers only the SCOUT_REPORT.md-written half of the statement (a real fixed-path locator, existence+nonempty); the 'candidates routed' half stays judgment -- no locator exists for whether a routing disposition was genuinely correct. Ships REPORT-ONLY (always exits 0, prints the real verdict to stdout) because this is the FIRST use of any check kind anywhere in this template -- zero live checks existed here before this promotion, so nothing in this file's own history supports shipping blocking (decision:blocking-where-adjudicated's default for a first-use file). Promotion trigger: after N clean report-only runs through this gate with zero false-refusals, reviewed at the next Cartographer/Scout-owning wave, flip to blocking by adding `"override_policy"` or dropping the trailing `; exit 0` -- a flag-flip, not a rebuild, same idiom as map_orient.py's own --report-only dial.

check.command: if [ -s "<repo-root>/.agent-work/SCOUT_REPORT.md" ]; then echo "PASS: SCOUT_REPORT.md written"; else echo "report-only: NOT gating -- SCOUT_REPORT.md missing or empty"; fi; exit 0
